evidence.detail: unlink() calls ps.load_people() with no discord_id filter, loading all persons in the DB
load_people() accepts a `where` parameter; adding p.discord_id IS NOT NULL would restrict to linked people only

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/controllers/admin.py:223, change the load_people call to pass where='p.discord_id IS NOT NULL' so only linked people are loaded. The same change applies at admin.py:206 (player_notes) and admin.py:51 if they also only need linked people, but the unlink page is the primary fix target.
triage.notes: The typeahead UX improvement mentioned in the issue body is a separate, larger feature and not part of the minimal fix.
